profile.name: Gamal Ahmed
profile.subtitle: Full-Stack Web Developer
profile.shortBio: I'm passionate about modern web technologies and creating fast, seamless, and scalable web applications for a superior user experience.
fullBio: Hello! I'm Gamal Ahmed, a dedicated Full Stack Developer with over 3 years of experience in building modern, scalable, and user-friendly web applications.

I started my journey with front-end development, mastering HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React. With time, I expanded my expertise to back-end technologies such as Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB, which enabled me to build complete, end-to-end solutions that deliver real value to users.
I'm passionate about writing clean, maintainable code and crafting seamless digital experiences. My goal is to develop applications that are fast, secure, easy to use, and optimized for performance.

projects.title: 3D Interactive E-Commerce Platform
projects.tagline: Immersive WebGL Shopping Experience with Real-Time 3D Product Customization
projects.description: An interactive web shopping experience allowing users to preview and configure products in 3D with real-time material inspection.
projects.overview: A state-of-the-art e-commerce application developed to revolutionize how customers inspect and purchase customizable products online. By leveraging Three.js and WebGL directly in the browser, users can rotate, inspect textures, change materials, and view dimensions in real-time 3D space with zero plugins required.
projects.problem: Shoppers faced uncertainty when buying products online without realistic spatial visualization. Traditional 2D product photos led to high return rates and customer hesitation.
projects.solution: Built a custom WebGL rendering canvas with Draco compression, allowing rapid 3D asset delivery, responsive orbit controls, and real-time material shading updates at 60 FPS.
projects.role: Lead Full-Stack & 3D Web Engineer. Designed the 3D scene architecture, optimized glTF/GLB models for low bandwidth, built the React customization UI, and integrated secure checkout APIs.
projects.impact: Boosted user session duration by 35%, lowered configuration abandonment by 28%, and achieved smooth 60fps rendering across desktop and mobile devices.

features.title: 360° Interactive 3D Viewport
features.desc: Smooth orbit controls with pinch-to-zoom and touch support for all mobile and desktop browsers.

features.title: Real-Time Material Customizer
features.desc: Instant live material and color swapping with realistic physically-based rendering (PBR) shaders.

features.title: Draco-Compressed 3D Assets
features.desc: Over 70% model size reduction ensuring initial load times under 1.5 seconds on standard 4G connections.

features.title: Seamless Cart Integration
features.desc: Configuration state saved directly into shopping cart with customized SKU generation for checkout.

projects.title: Food Ordering & Pizza Delivery App
projects.tagline: Fast, Real-Time Food Ordering System with Live Ingredient Customization
projects.description: Interactive food ordering application with dynamic ingredient customization, cart state management, and streamlined checkout.
projects.overview: A comprehensive online ordering application engineered for restaurants seeking an independent, commission-free digital storefront. Features interactive pizza building, real-time total calculation, address geolocation, and live order status updates.
projects.problem: Restaurant owners were losing up to 30% revenue to delivery aggregator fees and needed a bespoke ordering platform tailored to their menu customization workflows.
projects.solution: Engineered an end-to-end full-stack solution featuring Redux Toolkit for complex cart state, an Express order management API with rate limiting, and MongoDB collections for automated receipt generation.
projects.role: Engineered full client application with Redux Toolkit cart store, Node.js API endpoints, and MongoDB order persistence.
projects.impact: Reduced order processing time by 45% with instant client-side cart recalculations.

features.title: Visual Pizza Customizer
features.desc: Interactive crust, sauce, and topping selection with instant visual feedback and dynamic pricing.

features.title: Instant Cart Synchronization
features.desc: Persistent client-side cart state with coupon validation and tax calculation.

features.title: Live Order Tracking
features.desc: Visual milestone tracker showing preparation, baking, and out-for-delivery states.

features.title: Mobile-First Design
features.desc: Designed for one-thumb mobile ordering with smooth animations and haptic-like responsiveness.

projects.title: JobMatch Career Recruitment Portal
projects.tagline: Next-Gen Tech Job Board with Instant Stack Filtering and Candidate Tracking
projects.description: Tech job platform connecting software engineers with companies through targeted stack filtering and application tracking.
projects.overview: A specialized recruitment and talent matching platform tailored for software developers and tech recruiters. Features lightning-fast stack filtering, server-side rendered job listings for SEO indexing, and an intuitive applicant tracking dashboard.
projects.problem: Developers needed a clean platform to discover roles filtered specifically by programming stacks and seniority without cluttered non-tech postings.
projects.solution: Leveraged Next.js App Router with server-side rendering for optimal search engine indexing, compound MongoDB indexes for ultra-fast filtering, and a clean modern UI with Tailwind CSS.
projects.role: Built Next.js App Router application with SSR search indexing, applicant profile dashboard, and responsive UI.
projects.impact: Sub-second filtering across job listings with zero layout shift and 100/100 Lighthouse SEO score.

features.title: Multi-Stack Granular Search
features.desc: Filter by programming language, framework, seniority, salary, and remote availability simultaneously.

features.title: SEO-Optimized Server Components
features.desc: Pre-rendered job detail pages with JobPosting schema.org structured data for Google Jobs indexing.

features.title: Candidate Application Hub
features.desc: Track sent applications, interview stages, and direct recruiter messages in one dashboard.

features.title: Company Showcase Pages
features.desc: Branded employer profiles highlighting engineering culture, benefits, and current tech stack.

projects.title: Event Management & Reservation Dashboard
projects.tagline: Comprehensive Event Ticketing, Attendance Analytics & Revenue Management
projects.description: Centralized administrative portal for tracking event registrations, ticketing quotas, attendee check-ins, and revenue.
projects.overview: An end-to-end event management dashboard that streamlines ticket distribution, attendee quotas, registration tracking, and financial analytics for corporate conferences and cultural events.
projects.problem: Organizers were losing track of ticket sales and attendee quotas using fragmented spreadsheets, causing check-in bottlenecks and revenue reconciliation errors.
projects.solution: Designed an administrative dashboard with real-time quota tracking, MongoDB aggregations for analytics charts, and unique QR ticket verification endpoints.
projects.role: Developed administrative dashboard with React, Tailwind UI, Express backend controllers, and MongoDB aggregations.
projects.impact: Automated ticket tracking, eliminated manual spreadsheet errors, and slashed check-in wait times by 60%.

features.title: Real-Time Quota & Revenue Analytics
features.desc: Interactive KPI widgets tracking gross sales, available capacity, and ticket tier velocity.

features.title: Multi-Tier Ticket Management
features.desc: Custom pricing brackets (Early Bird, VIP, Student) with automated expiration triggers.

features.title: Fast QR Check-in System
features.desc: Sub-second attendee badge scanning and check-in confirmation to eliminate venue congestion.

features.title: CSV/PDF Export Center

projects.title: AI Conversational Support Assistant
projects.tagline: Intelligent Real-Time Chat Assistant with Streaming Responses & Intent Recognition
projects.description: Intelligent customer query assistant with real-time response streaming, intent recognition, and smooth error recovery.
projects.overview: An AI-powered customer support chatbot web interface built to deliver instant, contextual responses to customer inquiries. Designed with streaming message rendering, keyboard shortcuts, and intelligent fallback to human agents.
projects.problem: Customer service teams faced heavy queue delays answering repetitive inquiries during peak hours, leading to frustrated users.
projects.solution: Engineered a Next.js streaming interface with Server-Sent Events (SSE), markdown code syntax highlighting, conversation session persistence, and smart intent categorization.
projects.role: Implemented Next.js frontend with streaming response state, input debounce, and fallback error handlers.
projects.impact: Handled 65% of incoming inquiries automatically, achieving 24/7 coverage with an average response speed under 1.2s.
